{{Quote|You're joking. ''This'' is the defense for a twenty-five-thousand-year-old treaty?|Turg, upon being faced with the Klatooinains' defense|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''The Violation''' was an act of desecration that took place at the [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]] in the [[Derelkoos Desert]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] had [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|recently]] allied itself with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], and they stopped for a brief time on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. While there, [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] learned of the Fountain of the Ancients, and became obsessed with a desire to possess it. Eventually, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith decided to leave Klatooine and wait outside the Maw for [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]&mdash;who was soon to be arriving with an [[Rockhound|asteroid tug]] for help in navigating the Maw.

Taalon decided to leave two [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], the ''[[Starstalker]]'' and ''[[Winged Dagger]]'', under the command of [[Vyn Holpur]] and [[Leeha Faal]], respectively, behind to wait for Calrissian, although their actual intent was to obtain [[wintrium]] samples from the Fountain. Faal relayed Taalon's orders to Holpur, who carried them out. Taking his crew in the ''Starstalker'', Holpur led an assault on the Fountain. The Sith were met with resistance from primitively-armed [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards, and one of the Sith, [[Kaara]], was quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The Sith managed to take the wintrium samples, however, several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] soon arrived, as they were bound by the ancient [[Treaty of Vontor]] to protect the Fountain. They attacked the ''Starstalker'' and surrounded the ''Winged Dagger'', capturing the Sith and bringing them to trial. [[Darima Kedari]], [[Chancellor (Klatooinian)|Chancellor]] of the [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|Council of Elders]], requested that Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who had just arrived, mediate the situation.

Solo and Calrissian agreed, and during the ensuing hearing, Faal claimed that Holpur and his crew had acted of their own accord, and Holpur&mdash;though shocked by the betrayal&mdash;went along with her lie. Calrissian and Solo knew she was lying, but had no way to prove it, and were only able to convict Holpur and his crew of violating the Fountain. Holpur and the entire crew of the ''Starstalker'' were then sentenced to death for this crime. Solo and Calrissian also decreed that while the Hutts had failed to protect the Fountain, the [[Treaty of Vontor]] had not been breached, because the Hutts had reacted as swiftly and effectively as had been possible. Despite this ruling, Klatooinian's across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] began an [[Liberation|uprising]] against their Hutt rulers. Calrissian, Solo, Faal, and Faal's crew then met up with the rest of the Sith and Jedi outside the Maw to continue their mission.
